necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and transient neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks, corresponding to diagnosis codes R55 and G45.9. Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to evaluate for underlying arrhythmias or hemodynamic instability that may be contributing to these syncopal events and cerebral hypoperfusion. This clinical indication justifies the medical necessity of the service despite the denial based on Reason Code CO-197.
